svg.title: Signal or background? Majorana detector waveforms
svg.desc: Illustration: a pastel germanium crystal feeds one bold detector pulse drawn on taped graph paper; the pulse rise is highlighted with a marker and inspected through a magnifier held by a small cat-eared robot. A faint stack of many unlabelled waveforms sits behind it, and index tabs 'signal' (ticked) and 'background' stick out of the sheet. Stamped 検証済.
